scope: Outcome-blind business-definition amendment; historical v1 stays immutable.
line_grain: One source invoice line after the historical normalized exact-duplicate exclusion; invoice number is not a unique line key.
source_limits: UCI documents C-prefixed invoices as cancellations. Negative quantity alone does not establish a physical return, cause, original-sale linkage, cash collection, profit, or recognized accounting revenue.
eligible_line_policy: Preserve existing valid-net flags: exclude normalized duplicate copies, missing/blank descriptions and nonpositive unit prices. Missing customer IDs are retained for aggregate analysis, not imputed. No anomaly is automatically removed.

merchandise_policy.method: Historical project heuristic, not an externally verified product master
merchandise_policy.also_exclude: Normalized stock codes containing no digit
merchandise_policy.remaining_uncertainty: Digit-containing unrecognized adjustment codes may remain. Product/customer linkage does not establish accounting recognition.

category_policy: Code-based descriptive buckets only. All unmatched excluded codes join unknown_non_merchandise. No monetary value is allocated to a product without documented linkage.

negative_value_share_of_positive_percent.scope: all eligible lines in the same period

merchandise_net_transaction_value_gbp.scope: eligible lines not excluded by merchandise heuristic
merchandise_net_transaction_value_gbp.interpretation: Transaction-value proxy, not audited revenue or profit

negative_to_positive_unit_ratio_percenta.scope: same-period eligible merchandise lines for one stock code
negative_to_positive_unit_ratio_percenta.formula: 100 * abs(sum(quantity where quantity < 0)) / sum(quantity where quantity > 0)
negative_to_positive_unit_ratio_percenta.interpretation: May exceed 100%; not an original-sale-linked physical return rate

cancellation_evidence.invoice_flag: Invoice number starts with C, case-insensitive; independent of value sign and merchandise scope
cancellation_evidence.physical_returns: Not separately identifiable with available fields; do not report as confirmed returns
cancellation_evidence.positive_cancel_flagged_lines: Retain by sign in positive value; report flag/sign conflict separately

precision.audit_arithmetic: Decimal from source quantity and unit-price strings; aggregate before ROUND_HALF_UP to GBP 0.01; percentages to 0.01 percentage points
precision.historical_replay: Keep historical rounding and grouping for exact v1 replay; alternatives are explicitly labeled sensitivity scenarios
precision.confirmation_v1_1: Keep v1 numeric payloads only after independent Decimal aggregate audit within GBP 0.01; any larger mismatch blocks the amendment
precision.rank_ties: Numeric value descending, normalized stock code then description ascending; expose cutoff ties rather than claim a unique economic winner

scenario_policy: Scope and grain scenarios use the original question filters, not a newly sampled question set. Candidate-pair removal is retrospective sensitivity only; it does not prove linkage, delete source records, or change gold.
